question: Can I borrow and lend using one account?
expected_behavior_en: Yes; one account supports both roles.

question: هل يمكنني الاستعارة والإعارة بالحساب نفسه؟
expected_behavior_en: Yes; one account supports both roles.

question: Does sending a request reserve the item?
expected_behavior_en: No; owner acceptance is required.

question: هل إرسال الطلب يحجز الغرض؟
expected_behavior_en: No; owner acceptance is required.

question: When do I pay?
expected_behavior_en: After acceptance, before collection when payment is required; demo only.

question: متى أدفع؟
expected_behavior_en: After acceptance, before collection when payment is required; demo only.

question: Is a deposit part of the rental fee?
expected_behavior_en: No; display the refundable deposit separately.

question: هل مبلغ الضمان جزء من رسوم الاستئجار؟
expected_behavior_en: No; display the refundable deposit separately.

question: When will my deposit return?
expected_behavior_en: After confirmed return without an unresolved issue; do not promise an exact refund time.

question: متى أسترد مبلغ الضمان؟
expected_behavior_en: After confirmed return without an unresolved issue; do not promise an exact refund time.

question: Can free items require a deposit?
expected_behavior_en: Yes, if clearly shown; free refers to the rental fee.

question: هل يمكن اشتراط ضمان للإعارة المجانية؟
expected_behavior_en: Yes, if clearly shown; free refers to the rental fee.

question: How much is a 30-hour rental billed?
expected_behavior_en: Two daily units under the draft 24-hour rounding rule.

question: كيف تحسب مدة استئجار 30 ساعة؟
expected_behavior_en: Two daily units under the draft 24-hour rounding rule.

question: Can I keep the item for 20 days?
expected_behavior_en: The demo limit is 14 billable days; do not silently approve.

question: هل يمكنني الاحتفاظ بالغرض 20 يوماً؟
expected_behavior_en: The demo limit is 14 billable days; do not silently approve.

question: May I enter my real card number?
expected_behavior_en: No; payment records are simulated.

question: هل أدخل رقم بطاقتي الحقيقي؟
expected_behavior_en: No; payment records are simulated.

question: Who confirms that an item was returned?
expected_behavior_en: The owner confirms receipt after the borrower records return.

question: من يؤكد إرجاع الغرض؟
expected_behavior_en: The owner confirms receipt after the borrower records return.

question: Can I extend my booking?
expected_behavior_en: Ask the owner; availability and price must be checked again.

question: هل يمكنني تمديد الحجز؟
expected_behavior_en: Ask the owner; availability and price must be checked again.

question: Will a late reminder charge a fine?
expected_behavior_en: No automatic penalty is configured.

question: هل يفرض تذكير التأخير غرامة؟
expected_behavior_en: No automatic penalty is configured.

question: What if an accessory is missing?
expected_behavior_en: Report the issue with relevant condition evidence for review.

question: ماذا أفعل إذا فُقد أحد الملحقات؟
expected_behavior_en: Report the issue with relevant condition evidence for review.

expected_behavior_en: No; a report requires review, not automatic forfeiture.

expected_behavior_en: No; a report requires review, not automatic forfeiture.

question: Can I cancel before collection?
expected_behavior_en: Under draft demo rules yes, without penalty; collected amounts are refunded.

question: هل يمكنني الإلغاء قبل الاستلام؟
expected_behavior_en: Under draft demo rules yes, without penalty; collected amounts are refunded.

question: من يرى عنوان منزلي؟
expected_behavior_en: Public listings do not show an address; share only agreed handover details with authorized parties.

expected_behavior_en: No; reviews require a completed exchange.

question: Is insurance included?

expected_behavior_en: No insurance guarantee is configured; do not invent coverage.
